item.title: RFQ Input Checklist
item.description:
A useful first RFQ does not need every field to be final. It should show what is known, what is assumed, and what still needs confirmation.

Process media

Provide the chemical or fluid name, concentration or composition, pH where relevant, solids, oxidizing or solvent behavior, contaminants, cleaning fluids, and whether exposure is continuous, intermittent, or mixed.

Broad labels such as “acid,” “wastewater,” or “chemical service” are rarely enough to assess body, seat, seal, diaphragm, gasket, tubing, or accessory materials.

item.title: Wastewater Neutralization RFQ Scenario
item.description:
This is a representative planning scenario, not a disclosed customer project or a claim about delivered performance. Its purpose is to show how project information can be made reviewable before quotation.

Starting request

A wastewater neutralization area needs isolation valves, check protection, fittings, and several dosing accessories. The first list contains product names, pipe sizes, and quantities, but it mixes acid, alkali, transfer, drain, and flushing duties without identifying which line each item serves.
